Fig. 6. Illustration of complementary reasoning behaviors and reliability-aware arbitration in BELIEF. The upper panel shows a reasoning–answer mismatch in the neural LLM path, which is corrected through evidence-grounded symbolic reasoning. The lower panel presents a symbolic evidence insufficiency scenario, where high uncertainty in the D-S branch causes the arbitration mechanism to defer to the neural LLM path.
